title: Jib Crane

introduction.definition: A jib crane has a horizontal arm (jib) fixed to a vertical pillar or wall. The jib slews (rotates) around the pillar, and an electric hoist on a trolley travels along the jib. This covers a circular area around a workstation or machine.
applications: Maintenance of pumps, motors and valves
key_points: Foundation must take a large overturning moment
introduction.summary: A jib crane has a horizontal arm (jib) that slews around a pillar or wall bracket, with a trolley and hoist running along it. It serves a circular work area — ideal for a single workstation or machine tool.

foundation: Pillar on a reinforced foundation (or certified anchor system) designed for the overturning moment; check slab thickness and concrete strength.
alignment: Rails/beams within span, level and straightness tolerances; end stops and buffers fitted.
piping: Power supply via conductor rails, festoon or cable reel; mainline isolator accessible; pendant or radio control labelled with directions.
commissioning: Function-test all motions and limit switches (hoist upper/lower, travel); check brakes; proof load test and thorough examination by a competent person before first use, per the applicable standard and local regulations.

routine.task: Pre-use check of hoist, hook and slew.

periodic.task: Check anchor bolts and slew bearing.

overhaul.task: Thorough examination; replace slew bearing/hoist wear parts.

lubrication: Gearboxes: oil to grade and change interval; open gears and slew bearing: grease to schedule.
Wheels and pulley bearings: grease to schedule.

causes: Wear on sheaves/drum, overload, poor spooling
remedies: Inspect and discard per criteria (ISO 4309); correct reeving

safety: Keep slewing area clear; do not exceed rated load at maximum outreach.

script.narration: This module introduces the Jib Crane.
A jib crane has a horizontal arm (jib) fixed to a vertical pillar or wall.
The jib slews (rotates) around the pillar, and an electric hoist on a trolley travels along the jib.
This covers a circular area around a workstation or machine.
Typical applications include machine shops and workstations; loading bays; maintenance of pumps, motors and valves; shipboard and dockside use.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Jib Crane — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Jib Crane.
Pre-use check of hoist, hook and slew.
Check anchor bolts and slew bearing.
Thorough examination; replace slew bearing/hoist wear parts.
Watch for wire rope damage: broken wires, kinks, corrosion. Common cause: wear on sheaves/drum, overload, poor spooling.
Watch for brake failure: load drift, increased stopping distance. Common cause: worn linings, contamination, wrong adjustment.
Watch for overload: trip of limiter, structural deformation. Common cause: unknown load weight, side pulling.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
